hero_kpi_rationale: The CSS segment represents approximately 70% of the company's total revenue and is considered a key driver of future growth in neurosurgery and medical specialties.

kpis.name: CSS Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Codman Specialty Surgical segment, which represents approximately 70% of the company's total revenue.
kpis.description: The CSS segment specializes in technologies and instruments used for medical specialties such as neurosurgery, critical neurosurgery and otolaryngology (ENT). Integra is the global leader in neurosurgery.

kpis.name: TT Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Tissue Technologies segment, which represents approximately 30% of the company's total revenue.
kpis.description: The TT segment specializes in tissue regeneration technologies, wound reconstruction and wound care, as well as private label solutions.

kpis.name: Consolidated Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Company's consolidated leverage ratio as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: The company had a consolidated leverage ratio of 4.50 as of December 31, 2025, with a covenant requirement of 5.00. This ratio will decrease to 4.75 in the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company is expected to refinance all of its outstanding debt in 2026.

kpis.name: New Products Launched
kpis.explanation: Number and description of new products launched by the company during fiscal year 2025.
kpis.description: The company launched several new products in 2025 including Aurora Surgiscope (510k clearance), Mayfield Ghost Base Unit, and Durepair Dural Regeneration Matrix. The company continues to invest significantly in R&D to support new product launches and clinical evidence collection.

kpis.name: FDA Warning Letters
kpis.explanation: Status of FDA warning letters received for manufacturing facilities.
kpis.description: The company received an FDA warning letter on December 19, 2024 regarding quality systems issues identified in three facilities (Mansfield MA, Plainsboro NJ, Princeton NJ). A prior warning letter from 2023 concerned the Boston facility. The warning letters do not restrict the company's ability to manufacture or ship products; however, PMA applications for Class III devices will not be approved until the violations are corrected.

kpis.name: PMA Applications in Progress
kpis.explanation: Status of premarket approval (PMA) applications for Class III devices.
kpis.description: The company is pursuing PMA applications for SurgiMend (post-mastectomy breast reconstruction with approval pending GMP in 2026) and DuraSorb (implant-based reconstruction). PMA approval for DuraSorb is expected in 2026.

risks.title: High debt and refinancing required
risks.score_rationale: The company has a consolidated leverage ratio of 4.50 as of December 31, 2025 and must refinance all of its outstanding debt in 2026. The 2025 Notes valued at $575.0 million matured on August 15, 2025.

risks.title: Regulatory risks and FDA warning letters
risks.score_rationale: The company received an FDA warning letter on December 19, 2024 regarding quality systems issues in three facilities. PMA applications for Class III devices will not be approved until the violations are corrected.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks through its international operations, particularly in China, Japan and Europe where it is pursuing geographic expansion.

risks.title: Dependence on complex regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations as a medical device manufacturer, including EU MDR compliance, FDA inspections and PMA requirements.

risks.title: Quality implications and product recalls
risks.score_rationale: The company has initiated voluntary product recalls (Boston facility in May 2023, disposable patties and strips in 2024) following FDA inspections and quality systems issues identified.
